title: Engenheiro de Dados Especialista
description:

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Liderar a definição técnica e a evolução da estratégia de Data Lake, garantindo uma arquitetura robusta e escalável;
  • Desenhar e estruturar camadas de dados (Raw, Trusted, Refined) e fluxos de processamento baseados em padrões de ETL e ELT;
  • Estabelecer diretrizes para que a arquitetura suporte o crescimento de volume e complexidade da companhia;
  • Desenvolver e automatizar pipelines de dados complexos, garantindo a entrega eficiente para modelos preditivos e análises avançadas;
  • Otimizar continuamente o desempenho dos fluxos de dados, reduzindo latência e custos operacionais de processamento;
  • Implementar ferramentas e práticas que permitam a escalabilidade da modelagem de dados voltada à decisão estratégica;
  • Gerenciar o ciclo de vida da aquisição de dados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para os stakeholders;
  • Garantir a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados, estabelecendo processos de monitoramento e validação;
  • Atuar como ponte entre a tecnologia e as áreas de negócio, garantindo que as soluções de dados estejam alinhadas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Tecnologia.
  • Sólida experiência em pipelines e Big Data (Python/Java/Scala);
  • Vivência em liderança de equipes e metodologias ágeis;
  • Inglês avançado;

title: Channel Sales Representative
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Channel Sales Representative em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Channel Sales Manager


Location: Argentina or Brazil (remote with frequent regional travel)

Languages: Fluent Spanish and Portuguese; English required


Role Overview


We are the #1 smart pool cleaning robot company globally, leading innovation in intelligent outdoor robotics. As we continue our rapid global expansion, Latin America is one of our key growth regions. We are now building our local presence and looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to help drive this next stage of growth.


This is a high-impact, execution-focused role where you will work closely with distributors and retail partners to grow the brand, develop local markets, and deliver commercial results. You will play a key role in shaping our LATAM business from an early stage.


You will join a diverse, fast-growing, and entrepreneurial team where ownership, speed, and results matter. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys building markets rather than just managing them.


Key Responsibilities


Commercial Strategy & Market Development

  • Support the execution of LATAM sales plans across priority countries
  • Work with distributors to implement go-to-market activities and sales initiatives
  • Assist in building annual sales plans and forecasts with regional guidance
  • Support market expansion activities in selected countries and channels


Distributor & Retail Management

  • Manage day-to-day relationships with distributors and key retail partners
  • Support onboarding and activation of new distribution partners
  • Assist in pricing alignment, promotions, and product assortment execution
  • Monitor basic sell-in / sell-out performance and flag risks or opportunities
  • Support in-store execution including product visibility and promotions


Sales Execution & Performance Management

  • Track and report sales performance across assigned markets
  • Support KPI monitoring including sell-in, sell-out, and inventory levels
  • Assist in preparation of sales reports and market updates
  • Gather competitor and market insights from distributors and retailers


Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with supply chain and logistics teams on order and delivery tracking
  • Support marketing and sales teams in adapting materials for local markets
  • Provide regular feedback from distributors and customers



Preferred Backgrounds

  • Pool equipment, home appliances, consumer electronics, or similar industries
  • Experience working with distributors or retail partners in Latin America
  • Exposure to B2B or channel sales environments is a strong plus


Experience & Qualifications Required

  • 5+ years of sales or channel management experience in Latin America
  • Experience working with distributors, retailers, or sales partners
  • Understanding of retail or channel-based sales models
  • Fluent Spanish required; Portuguese (Brazil) is a strong advantage
  • Good level of English for internal communication
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, international environment
  • Willingness to travel within Latin America


Profile & Soft Skills

  • Hands-on and execution-oriented
  • Strong relationship builder with distributors and customers
  • Practical, structured, and reliable in follow-through
  • Comfortable working independently with guidance from HQ
  • Curious and eager to grow into a regional leadership role


What Success Looks Like (First 12–18 Months)

  • Clear distributor structure in priority LATAM markets.
  • Consistent sell-in growth supported by improving sell-out performance.
  • Strong retail presence with controlled inventory and margin discipline.
  • Reliable forecasting and structured market reporting.
  • LATAM positioned as a scalable and repeatable growth region.

title: Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Médico Oncologista Genético (com RQE) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ONCOLOGISTA GENÉTICO NA TELADOC HEALTH\"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas em Oncologia Genética! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Oncologia Genética, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Oncologista Genético de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios oncológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças de ordem Oncologista Genética.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Oncologista Genética.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ONCOLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Oncologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Oncologia sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO


Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Oncologista.

title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
description:

Job Title: Senior Backend Software Engineer (Java/Kotlin)

Location: Brazil, Costa Rica, Colombia

Work Mode: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Independent Contractor (Hourly, no benefits, candidate responsible for taxes)

Contract Duration: 6 Months (with possibility of extension)

Working Hours: 40 hours per week


Role Overview

  • Senior Software Engineer on a newly formed Item Domain team (Sales & Retail: Pricing, Pay, and Merch Tools) for an authenticated luxury resale marketplace.
  • Focus on rebuilding core item data systems (pricing, merchandising, enrichment) through a mix of greenfield development and legacy system integration.
  • This is a high-impact role contributing to a long-term transformation of core data systems, leveraging modern backend technologies and AI-assisted development.
  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering leadership in a fast-moving, cross-functional environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code contributing to company-wide initiatives.
  • Develop backend services and internal tooling using JVM (Java, Kotlin) as a core focus, along with existing systems in Python and Ruby.
  • Build and support web applications for shoppers and operators (listing, enrichment, merchandising).
  • Work with technologies including React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB.
  • Contribute to technical decisions shaping future software systems and architecture.
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to peers.
  • Collaborate through pair programming and support onboarding when needed.
  • Deploy user-facing code to production responsibly.
  • Partner closely with product managers, engineering leadership, and stakeholders across regions.
  • Ensure observability and reliability by learning from metrics and incidents and maintaining systems.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and engineering workflows.
  • Continuously learn and apply new technologies, patterns, and initiatives.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 3–5+ years of strong backend software engineering experience.
  • Experience with Java or another backend language, with willingness to work with Kotlin (JVM-based systems).
  • Experience building and maintaining production-ready, reliable, and secure systems.
  • Understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong communication skills with product, stakeholders, and engineering peers (fluent English required ).
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with distributed and US-based teams.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, TypeScript, version control, and deployment tools.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with focus on user impact and business context.
  • Openness to using AI-assisted coding tools in daily development workflows.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with JVM services (Java, Kotlin) in production environments.
  • Experience with Python or Ruby.
  • Experience with web technologies: JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, React.
  • Experience building microservices and working across distributed systems.
  • Experience integrating LLMs or managed AI APIs into backend or internal tools.
  • Experience with eCommerce platforms.
  • Experience working with CMS tools (especially Prismic).
  • Experience with monitoring, dashboards, and incident response in production.


What We’re Looking For

  • Backend-strong engineer (full-stack experience is a plus).
  • Adaptable and fast learner with flexibility across technologies.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-moving, and greenfield environments .
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently.
  • Excellent communicator and collaborative team player.
  • Open to AI-assisted development workflows and modern engineering practices.

As part of Zoolatech’s distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.


By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.

  • Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems
  • Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang
  • Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams
  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.

  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis.


Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão.Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes.Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência.Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade.Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização.Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica).Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário.Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica.Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio.Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados.Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics.Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX).Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker .Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico.Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados.Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold).Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI).Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse.Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações.Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards.Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Requisitos desejáveis

Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.


Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.


Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).


Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.


Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Experiência com testes e validação de dados.


Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;

100% remoto;

Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

Fully remote position.

Fast paced environment with rapid learning.

Performance driven culture focused on output and results.

title: Finance Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Finance Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time


Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.


About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.


The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.


This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment


This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment


What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking


Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)


Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy


Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

About Us

Familiarity with AI workflow automation and tools.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Accountant em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Join a team that values you. At StaffRight, we connect talented professionals with global opportunities—and we’re growing fast! With competitive pay, health insurance, paid time off (including national holidays), and a supportive HR team always in your corner, you’ll love building your career with us.


We’re looking for a detail-oriented Accountant to support our client with day-to-day accounting operations, financial reporting, and reconciliation processes within NetSuite.   • Minimum 3+ years of accounting experience

  • Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Available to work in US time zones (Graveyard shift in the Philippines)
  • Available to start within 2 weeks from job offer


Technical Requirements:

  • Comfortable in using time-trackers (e.g. Time Doctor)
  • Own laptop/desktop, noise-cancelling headphones, and webcam
  • Reliable internet connection (at least 50 Mbps)

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

Competitive Compensation

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Financial Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior Financial Analyst


Location: Remote (Brazil)


About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.



Position Overview


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.



What You'll Do:


  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.



What You Bring:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.


Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture


Skills Required

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services
  • Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently
  • English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Python
  • Familiarity with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, GraphQL, or JVM languages
  • Experience working in fast-paced MVP or startup-like environments

This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.

To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.

Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

description:

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.


The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.


Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred


Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.


As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: Analista Data Viz Sr.
description:

Esse(a) profissional será responsável por transformar dados em narrativas visuais claras, eficientes e orientadas ao negócio, indo além da construção de dashboards e garantindo que toda a jornada dos dados — desde as camadas analíticas até a visualização — seja confiável, performática e escalável.


O desafio envolve atuar com grandes volumes de dados em ambientes cloud, estruturando e preparando dados nas camadas analíticas (especialmente Silver e Gold), organizando métricas e regras de negócio, e construindo visualizações que realmente gerem valor para as áreas.


Buscamos alguém com forte pensamento analítico, domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados e experiência prática na preparação e modelagem de dados para consumo em BI. Mais do que dominar ferramentas específicas, esperamos alguém que entenda profundamente como dados se transformam em informação e decisão.


Como Analista de Data Visualization Sênior, você atuará em conjunto com times multidisciplinares, sendo a ponte entre dados e negócio, garantindo que as soluções analíticas sejam compreensíveis, confiáveis e acionáveis.


Se você gosta de contar histórias com dados, estruturar informações de forma inteligente e atuar próximo ao negócio para gerar impacto real, essa oportunidade é para você.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver dashboards e produtos de dados focados em geração de insights e suporte à tomada de decisão.Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções visuais claras, intuitivas e eficientes.Atuar na preparação e transformação de dados nas camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold), garantindo qualidade e consistência.Modelar dados para consumo em ferramentas de BI, aplicando boas práticas de performance e escalabilidade.Definir e organizar métricas e KPIs em conjunto com as áreas de negócio, promovendo padronização.Aplicar princípios de Data Visualization (design, storytelling, hierarquia de informação, UX analítica).Otimizar dashboards e queries visando melhor performance e experiência do usuário.Garantir a qualidade dos dados utilizados nas visualizações por meio de validações e consistência lógica.Trabalhar em parceria com Analytics Engineers, Data Engineers e áreas de negócio.Documentar dashboards, métricas e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível.Apoiar na definição de boas práticas de visualização, modelagem e consumo de dados.Contribuir para a evolução da cultura data-driven na organização.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics.Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX).Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker .Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico.Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados.Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold).Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI).Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse.Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações.Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards.Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Requisitos desejáveis

Experiência com Python aplicado a análise e visualização de dados.


Conhecimento em frameworks de visualização interativa como Streamlit.


Experiência com construção de produtos de dados além de dashboards (apps analíticos, data products).


Vivência com grandes volumes de dados e ambientes distribuídos.


Conhecimento em versionamento de código e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.


Experiência com testes e validação de dados.


Remuneração CLT compatível com o mercado;

100% remoto;

Flash - Cartão de Benefícios Flexíveis com todas as categorias habilitadas: Alimentação, Refeição, Mobilidade, Educação, Saúde e Cultura;

Experiência sólida com Data Visualization, BI ou Analytics.Domínio dos fundamentos de visualização de dados (storytelling, design, percepção visual, UX).Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Tableau e Looker .Conhecimento em modelagem de dados para consumo analítico.Domínio em SQL para exploração, transformação e validação de dados.Experiência com preparação de dados (ETL/ELT), especialmente em camadas analíticas (Silver e Gold).Conhecimento em linguagens das ferramentas de BI, como DAX e Linguagem M (Power BI).Familiaridade com ambientes de dados em cloud e conceitos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou Lakehouse.Capacidade de entender regras de negócio e traduzi-las em métricas e visualizações.Experiência com otimização de queries e performance de dashboards.Boa comunicação para interação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

As part of Zoolatech’s distributed engineering team, you will join the Market Innovation team - a fast-moving internal innovation group focused on building and delivering new product initiatives across multiple domains and services. Unlike traditional product teams, this team operates across different repositories, architectures, and backend ecosystems, taking ownership of complex discovery-driven projects from investigation to MVP delivery.


By joining Zoolatech, you will work closely with senior engineering leadership and global stakeholders in a highly autonomous environment that values ownership, adaptability, strong communication, and engineering curiosity.

  • Investigate and understand existing backend services and distributed systems
  • Design and implement backend solutions primarily using Golang
  • Work on MVP delivery from technical discovery through implementation
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders across multiple domains and teams
  • Communicate technical findings and proposed solutions clearly
  • Adapt quickly to new codebases, services, and technologies
  • Contribute to scalable and maintainable backend architecture


Skills Required

  • Strong commercial experience with Golang
  • Strong background in backend development, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Experience building event-driven architectures using messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS/SNS
  • Solid understanding of testing practices, including unit and end-to-end testing
  • Strong knowledge of relational databases
  • Ability to quickly understand and navigate unfamiliar codebases and services
  • Strong problem-solving and backend investigation skills
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently
  • English level sufficient for direct communication with international teams

Nice to Have

This is an independent contractor opportunity based on a direct contractual relationship between Zoolatech and the individual service provider.

To facilitate this direct partnership, we engage with professionals who are registered and operate as a sole proprietorship, private entrepreneur, or an equivalent self-employment status in your country.

Please note, our model does not accommodate contracts through third-party intermediaries such as agencies, incubators, or umbrella companies. The essential requirement is your ability to enter into a service agreement and invoice Zoolatech directly. This is not an offer of direct employment

title: Data Software Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Data Software Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Role Details:


We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.


Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.


Qualifications: What you bring to the team


You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.


You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

description:
